# Action reference

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-docs.ts, do not edit by hand (just docs-gen) -->

Every action is a chat command (`!name args`), an LLM tool and a typed call (`agent.act(name, params)`).
Positional chat arguments follow the parameter order below; `key=value` works too.

7 skills, 28 actions.

## combat

Fighting hostile mobs and guarding players.

### `attack`

Fight the nearest hostile mob, or a specific entity by id.

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entityId` | number |  |  | entity id; default nearest hostile mob |
| `radius` | number |  | `16` |  |

### `guard`

Stay near a player and kill hostile mobs that come close to them, until stopped.

*long-running*

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `player` | string |  |  | player to protect; defaults to the requesting player |
| `radius` | number |  | `12` |  |

### `defend`

Fight back against whatever hostile mob is closest (used by reflexes).

*internal*

No parameters.

## gather

Mining and collecting blocks.

### `collect`

Mine a number of blocks of one type nearby and pick up the drops. Needs digging enabled.

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `block` | string | yes |  | block name, e.g. oak_log |
| `count` | integer (1..64) |  | `1` |  |

## inventory

Inventory management.

### `inventory`

List what the bot is carrying.

*non-exclusive · aliases: `inv`*

No parameters.

### `drop`

Throw items towards the requesting player (or on the ground). item="all" drops everything.

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `item` | string |  | `"all"` | item name, or "all" |
| `count` | integer (..9007199254740991) |  |  | how many; default the whole stack(s) |

### `equip`

Hold an item in the main hand.

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `item` | string | yes |  |  |

## movement

Walking around: come, follow, goto.

### `come`

Walk to a player (default: whoever asked).

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `player` | string |  |  | player name; defaults to the requesting player |

### `follow`

Follow a player, staying close, until stopped.

*long-running*

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `player` | string |  |  | player name; defaults to the requesting player |
| `distance` | number (1..16) |  | `2` | how close to stay, in blocks |

### `goto`

Walk to block coordinates. Omit y to go to the surface at x/z.

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | number | yes |  |  |
| `y` | number |  |  |  |
| `z` | number | yes |  |  |

### `goto_player`

Walk to where a player currently is (one-off, does not keep following).

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `player` | string | yes |  |  |

### `look_at`

Turn to look at a player.

*non-exclusive*

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `player` | string |  |  |  |

### `jump`

Jump once.

*non-exclusive*

No parameters.

## navigation

Home, wandering and named places.

### `wander`

Take a short walk to a random spot within a radius of home (or of a given center, or of where the bot stands).

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `radius` | number (1..64) |  | `12` | how far from the center to wander, in blocks |
| `x` | number |  |  | center x; default home, else current position |
| `z` | number |  |  | center z |

### `set_home`

Remember a home position (default: where the bot stands now).

*non-exclusive*

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | number |  |  |  |
| `y` | number |  |  |  |
| `z` | number |  |  |  |

### `go_home`

Walk back to the remembered home position.

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `range` | number (0..16) |  | `2` | how close to get, in blocks |

### `remember_place`

Remember a named place (default: where the bot stands now), to walk back to later with goto_place.

*non-exclusive*

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  |  |
| `x` | number |  |  |  |
| `y` | number |  |  |  |
| `z` | number |  |  |  |

### `forget_place`

Forget a named place.

*non-exclusive*

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  |  |

### `places`

List home and remembered places.

*non-exclusive*

No parameters.

### `goto_place`

Walk to a place remembered with remember_place.

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  |  |
| `range` | number (0..16) |  | `2` |  |

### `flee`

Run away from the nearest hostile mob until it is a safe distance away.

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `distance` | number (4..32) |  | `16` | how far to get from the mob |

## status

Status, stop and chat.

### `pos`

Report the bot's position.

*non-exclusive · aliases: `where`*

No parameters.

### `hp`

Report health, food and what the bot is doing.

*non-exclusive · aliases: `status`*

No parameters.

### `stop`

Stop whatever the bot is doing.

*non-exclusive*

No parameters.

### `say`

Say something in public chat.

*non-exclusive*

| param | type | required | default | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | yes |  |  |

## survival

Eating and sleeping.

### `eat`

Eat the best food in the inventory.

No parameters.

### `sleep`

Sleep in a bed within 16 blocks (only works at night or during storms).

No parameters.

### `wake`

Get out of bed.

No parameters.
